attchmntText: Please find enclosed extract of newspaper advertisement regarding publication of Unaudited Financial Results of the Company, for the quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: DCM Sugar Mills Limited published newspaper advertisements on November 14, 2026, regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 13, 2026. The results are accessible via a Quick Response Code and the company website. Sharika Enterprises Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved these results on November 13, 2026. The company engaged in Engineering and EPC activities. The consolidated financial results received a modified opinion from statutory auditors. The holding company allotted 1,21,92,125 equity shares at Rs. 14.33 per share and issued 28,12,315 convertible warrants at Rs. 14.33 per warrant.

attchmntText: DCM Limited has informed the exchange regarding Contact details of persons authorized for determining materiality of an event or information and its disclosure to the Stock Exchanges.
voiceSummary: DCM Limited has authorized Mr. Vinay Sharma, Managing Director, Mr. Ashwani Kumar Singhal, Chief Financial Officer, and Ms. Neha Dheman, Company Secretary, to determine the materiality of events and disclose information to stock exchanges. This authorization applies to any two of these officials. The designation is effective from November 16, 2026. The Board of Directors approved this arrangement during its meeting held on November 13, 2026. The disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30(5) of SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015. Contact details for the authorized persons include the email investors@dcm.in and phone number 011-41539170. This information will also be available on the company website at www.dcm.in.

attchmntText: Board comments on fine levied by the Exchange
voiceSummary: DCM Limited disclosed board comments on fines levied by the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited for non-compliance with Regulation 17(1) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The non-compliance involved a delay in ensuring at least one-third of the board comprised independent directors. The NSE notice dated August 25, 2026, imposed a fine of Rs. 35,000 plus GST of Rs. 6,300, totaling Rs. 41,300. The board meeting held on November 13, 2026, noted the unintentional delay attributed to the time taken to identify a suitable independent director candidate. The company confirmed that the fines along with applicable GST were paid within the stipulated timeline. The board emphasized timely compliance and advised strengthening internal monitoring mechanisms to avoid recurrence.

attchmntText: DCM  Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP

DCM  Limited has informed the Exchange about resignation of Ms. Sonal Gupta, Company Secretary & Compliance Officer of the Company w.e.f. November 15, 2026 and appointment of Ms. Neha Dheman as the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of the Company with effect from November 16, 2026.
voiceSummary: DCM Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Ms. Sonal Gupta resigned as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective November 15, 2026. Ms. Neha Dheman was appointed to the same position effective November 16, 2026. The Board approved the proposed sale of approximately 38.38 acres of land in Vellore District, Tamil Nadu, subject to shareholder approval under Section 180(1)(a) of the Companies Act, 2013. The company reported a loss of 250 lakhs for the six months ended September 30, 2026. A lockout at the Engineering Division in Punjab since October 22, 2019, remains sub-judice. No provision has been made for workmen wages aggregating 3,132 lakhs related to the lockout period.
